scenario: Mixed-type interval `overlaps` per LINT.4.2 — both intervals must have matching element types. `Int`-interval `overlaps` `Time`-interval rejects with DS_VALIDATE_TYPE_MISMATCH.
rules_ds:
schema Check scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    i_start: Int mutable
    i_end: Int mutable
    t_start: Time mutable
    t_end: Time mutable

rule r:
    Check c where (c.i_start..c.i_end) overlaps (c.t_start..c.t_end)
->
    log info "x"
